card.name: Words just before a member or group noun
card.fires_on: Small words like "other", "a", and "to" where the next word could plausibly be "member(s)" or a group name. Seen in phrases like "other members of the healthcare team" and "offers the feature to signed-up members".

modes.label: "other" before a group
modes.description: The word "other" in a list or comparison, where a group noun such as members or NSAIDs follows.
modes.example: Frequent communication is important among the prescriber,<< other>> members of the healthcare team, the patient

modes.label: "to" or "a" before people
modes.description: A linking word before a type of person or user, such as members or a physician.
modes.example: MyARKive offers the scrapbook feature<< to>> signed-up members, allowing you to organize

modes.label: Other small linking words
modes.description: Occasional other small words such as "(" appear with no clear link to members.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying "member" or "members" next, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on small words that often come right before the word "members", such as "other" in "other members of the team".
